title: SSE turn stream polls DynamoDB at 50ms with no backoff or deadman timeout
description: In python/src/chatticus/http/app.py, the stream_turn endpoint polls state.plane.list_turn_events(tenant_id, turn_id, replay_from) inside a while True loop sleeping only 0.05 seconds (20 polls per second). At 20 queries/sec, every active SSE stream issues 1,200 DynamoDB Query requests per minute. If a worker hangs or crashes without emitting a terminal event, the stream generator loops indefinitely until client disconnect or the 15-minute Lambda limit (up to 18,000 queries per abandoned turn). Introduce adaptive backoff and a deadman timeout.
